Third-party front-end libraries, served from this server (the Content-Security-Policy allows no CDN scripts):
  leaflet.js / leaflet.css / images/*   Leaflet 1.9.4   (BSD-2-Clause)  integrity-checked against the official hashes
  leaflet-heat.js                       leaflet.heat 0.2.0 (MIT)
Tailwind is not loaded at run time: frontend/tailwind.css is pre-built (npm run build:css in the project root).
